risk_tier_scheme.A: Authoritative source artifact is publicly verifiable and the counted whole-chain boundary is clear from non-label metadata.
risk_tier_scheme.B: An authoritative artifact exists, but execution-boundary, cross-source overlap, representation, or full-coverage risk can materially reduce the count.
risk_tier_scheme.C: The authoritative original payload artifact is unavailable or has not been verified; the count is metadata-only and cannot support intake planning without replacement evidence.
risk_tier_scheme.EXCLUDED: The source is frozen out of C13+ recruitment or contributes no current candidate credit for a separate governance reason.
